carried_by: the whole-container transport companion of a pack: for each resource of an RCM1 manifest, the source container it travels in and its span there; named by the SHA-256 of its own bytes
header: magic (4), version 1 (u32), rows 1 to 64 (u32), row bytes 96 (u32), the scene's digest (32 bytes), the RCM1 manifest's digest (32 bytes), the transport model's digest (32 bytes: SHA-256 of the model's name)
row: raw (u32: 1 when the container is the resource itself), 0 (u32), the container's digest (32 bytes), the content's digest (32 bytes), the container's bytes (u64), the span's offset (u64), the span's bytes (u64)
rules: the file is exactly the header and its rows, one a resource of the manifest
the reader is given the companion's digest, the scene's and the manifest, and refuses bytes that don't match them
a span is inside its container, and its bytes are the resource's encoded size
a raw container's span is the whole container, and its digest the content's

fixture.source: the one resource of the RCM1 profile's manifest as a raw container of its own four bytes, in the scene "format-profile-scene" (format-profile.coax fp_htp1, written by hpt_write)

refused.what: a span one byte into its container
